digest.component_or_area: tickets store git maintenance and history reclaim
propositions: Spent ~1 GiB of tickets-store repository objects must be reclaimed via history rewrite and gc/prune to bring the filtered pack below CI gate limit (131072 KiB) and restore headroom for stale-based change submissions.

History rewrite using git fast-export/filter/fast-import must preserve tree, commit count, merge count, and identity-report multisets while stripping unreachable .bridge_state history, with exact force-with-lease publication and verification that old tip has no ancestor refs in published clone.

All writers must remain paused and all active sessions halted during the coordinated quiet-window operation, with explicit operator confirmation before any tracker convergence, backup creation, repair execution, or history mutation.

Prerequisite bug repair (ticket 30d3) must complete with fsck clean and exact four intentional fork-resolved records before the rewrite begins, and a final backup must be created and verified post-repair but pre-rewrite.

The deterministic first post-rewrite write must be the sole canonical review-bot vote with opportunistic enrichment disabled, measured for size growth below 1 MiB and retention of non-ancestry property, then workflow/timer/agents restored with final reconciliation validated green.

All 32 acceptance criteria must be met and operator-attested via signed receipts, including tree/count/identity equivalence, pack size, no old-tip ancestry, successful first write, and post-enable reconciler pass before sessions resume.
